You are a programming expert. 
        You will be provided with a patch used to fix a bug. 
        Based on the commit message and modifications in the patch, you need to analyze the root cause of the bug in detail. 

        Here is the patch content:
        From 58f9f135630fb4f5557f36c0b2d87e50f3afcf08 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: jeanlf <jeanlf@github.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Apr 2020 14:38:10 +0200
Subject: [PATCH] fixed bug introduced by cdc5d3a3

---
 src/filter_core/filter.c | 4 +++-
 1 file changed, 3 insertions(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/src/filter_core/filter.c b/src/filter_core/filter.c
index d765c1d02..93e9672d3 100644
--- a/src/filter_core/filter.c
+++ b/src/filter_core/filter.c
@@ -1810,7 +1810,9 @@ static void gf_filter_renegociate_output(GF_Filter *filter, Bool force_afchain_i
 
 void gf_filter_renegociate_output_task(GF_FSTask *task)
 {
-	gf_filter_renegociate_output(task->filter, GF_TRUE);
+	//it is possible that the cap renegociation was already done at the time we process this task
+	if (task->filter->nb_caps_renegociate)
+		gf_filter_renegociate_output(task->filter, GF_TRUE);
 }
 
 static void gf_filter_check_pending_tasks(GF_Filter *filter, GF_FSTask *task)
-- 
2.25.1


        
        Provide a response strictly in the following format:
        Root cause:<Root cause>

Root cause: The bug was caused by a lack of a check to prevent invoking the `gf_filter_renegociate_output` function when the capabilities (caps) had already been renegotiated. This led to unnecessary processing and potential issues if the task was processed after the renegotiation had already taken place. The patch adds a condition to ensure that this function is only called if `task->filter->nb_caps_renegociate` is non-zero, indicating that renegotiation is needed.

Root cause:
The bug was caused by a lack of a check to prevent invoking the `gf_filter_renegociate_output` function when the capabilities (caps) had already been renegotiated. This led to unnecessary processing and potential issues if the task was processed after the renegotiation had already taken place. The patch adds a condition to ensure that this function is only called if `task->filter->nb_caps_renegociate` is non-zero, indicating that renegotiation is needed.
